name: tracker-cutover-cli
goal: Compare two quiesced Tracker SQLite snapshots and their pending sync operations through the shared Harness CLI.

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Native read-only check of explicitly named local SQLite backup copies. Verify schema, all typed rows and configured link queues. Return a nonzero status for a mismatch. Keep all existing Tracker command routing unchanged.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: The native CLI subcommand passes explicit local backup paths and selected sync-link modes into TrackerSnapshotAdapter. It emits only the comparison result on stdout, and separates mismatch from unverified input.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
Run the relevant project verification commands.
